parameters.text:
=You are a B2B company enrichment assistant.

Research the company connected to this domain:
{{ $('Parse Booking From Calendly').item.json.company_domain }}

Prospect email:
{{ $('Parse Booking From Calendly').item.json.email }}
Use the available web search tool when needed to identify the company and extract reliable public information.

Rules:
- Do not guess.
- Use only credible public sources.
- If a field is unknown, return null.
- If the company cannot be confidently identified, set enrichment_status to "not_found".
- Return only the required structured JSON format.
- Include source URLs used for the enrichment.
- For technologies and source_urls, always return an array. If unknown or unavailable, return [].
- Never return null for technologies or source_urls.
Your final response must contain exactly one top-level field called output. Put all enrichment fields inside output. Do not return enrichment fields at the top level.

parameters.content:
## Workflow Overview

This workflow automates Calendly booking intake into HubSpot. It parses a Calendly booking email, validates the prospect record, upserts the HubSpot contact, records booking notes, enriches business-email leads, calculates ICP fit, and sends a meeting briefing.

The workflow uses placeholders for credentials, workflow IDs, recipient emails, cache sheet IDs, and sample execution data so it can be shared safely. Reconnect credentials and replace placeholders after importing into a private n8n environment.

## Lead Intake

Triggered by a Calendly notification email in Gmail.

The parser extracts booking details into structured fields such as prospect name, email, company domain, booking event ID, meeting start time, lead source, lifecycle stage, and booking notes.

Only valid prospect bookings continue into CRM creation. Invalid or incomplete bookings are routed to manual review.

## CRM Creation

The workflow validates the booking and upserts the prospect as a HubSpot contact using the email address as the primary identity key.

HubSpot handles company association from the email domain, so this workflow does not add separate company-matching logic.

The HubSpot contact ID is preserved for later ICP updates and meeting briefing generation.

## Booking Note

If Calendly booking notes are present, the workflow creates a HubSpot note and associates it with the contact.

This preserves prospect intent, meeting context, requested topics, or additional comments from the booking form.

Empty booking notes are skipped to avoid noisy CRM activity.

## Enrichment And Qualification

Business email leads enter the enrichment path. Personal email domains skip enrichment to reduce unnecessary API usage and avoid low-confidence research.

The workflow processes companies one at a time to reduce rate-limit risk. It first checks the Google Sheets enrichment cache by company domain. If a cached record exists, the workflow reuses it. If no record exists, it waits briefly, then uses an AI Agent with a chat model, SerpAPI web search, and a structured output parser to collect company-level data.

The normalized AI enrichment result is saved back to the cache so future bookings from the same company can reuse the same company profile instead of triggering another web search. Array fields such as technologies and source URLs are converted to readable text before saving to Google Sheets.

The enriched company profile is evaluated for ICP fit using signals such as industry, employee count, geography, enterprise sales motion, funding stage, technology context, and confidence level.

If enrichment fails, returns no reliable company match, or cannot produce the required structured output, the workflow routes the booking to manual review instead of failing the entire intake process.

The final ICP score is saved back to the HubSpot contact.

## Meeting Briefing

After ICP scoring, the workflow builds a meeting briefing from the CRM contact, booking details, enrichment result, source URLs, and ICP score.

The briefing is sent through Gmail so the meeting owner has useful context before speaking with the prospect.

## Manual Review

Bookings are routed here when validation fails, required fields are missing, or enrichment cannot confidently identify the company.

Manual review keeps the workflow resilient: CRM intake can continue while records that need human judgment are clearly separated from the automated success path.

## Setup Checklist

Before running this workflow in production, configure:
- Gmail trigger and send credentials
- HubSpot private app token credential
- OpenAI credential for the AI Agent chat model
- SerpAPI credential for company research
- Google Sheets cache document and sheet tab
- HubSpot contact property for ICP score
- Review recipient or process for failed enrichment

Keep cache rows keyed by company_domain to deduplicate enrichment across multiple bookings.
